attempt.title: MOON original cross-method claim
attempt.idea: Test whether prior-role entanglement is a mechanism shared across independent methods.
attempt.mechanism: Prior role entanglement changes the effective intervention response across methods and must be separated from single-implementation artifacts.
attempt.failure_condition: The effect appears in only one implementation or disappears under an artifact control.
assumptions: The same intervention can be applied across methods
attempt.differentiator: Cross-method controlled intervention rather than a single-method observation

evidence.title: MOON single-method limitation
evidence.excerpt: 单方法实现中观察到的现象，不能直接证明跨方法的“先验角色纠缠”机制成立。

evidence.title: MOON mechanism repaint decision
evidence.excerpt: 如果新提案只把已知 confirmation bias 或提示敏感性问题换成新术语，却没有改变因果条件，则不应作为新的机制贡献继续投入。

attempt.title: IBML broad phase diagram
attempt.idea: Map a broad reliability and complementarity phase diagram across tasks and models.
attempt.mechanism: Reliability and complementarity jointly determine a broad phase diagram of collaboration performance across tasks and models.
attempt.failure_condition: A near-neighbor problem or a trivial estimator already explains the same phase structure.
assumptions: Reliability and complementarity are identifiable from observations

evidence.title: IBML broad question coverage
evidence.excerpt: 宽的“可靠性 × 互补性相图”已被近邻问题覆盖。仅更换任务、模型或坐标术语，没有形成可辩护的机制差异。

evidence.title: IBML remaining identifiability condition
evidence.excerpt: 只有收窄到“可观测控制统计量的不可识别性”，并明确哪个观测条件改变了旧结论，才允许进入 CONDITIONAL GO。

evidence.title: IBML trivial explanation control
evidence.excerpt: 简单加权、阈值或现有估计器若能解释相同现象，就不能把相图本身当作充分的新机制证据。

attempt.title: CodeAlign mechanism baseline
attempt.idea: Test whether representation alignment causes robust code transfer under a matched data intervention.
attempt.mechanism: Representation alignment mediates robust code transfer when data composition is controlled and the checkpoint supports the required intervention.
attempt.failure_condition: The required checkpoint or minimum data is unavailable, or the alignment intervention has no discriminating effect.
attempt.differentiator: Matched data composition with a direct representation intervention

evidence.title: CodeAlign early mechanism review
evidence.excerpt: 当时机制问题与工程条件需要分开判断。若只回放该日期前已可用的材料，不能引入后续工程否决来改写当时的机制建议。

evidence.title: CodeAlign later engineering review
evidence.excerpt: 后续检查发现所需数据与 checkpoint 不满足条件，继续追加研究投入无法形成最小闭环。

attempt.title: MOON repaint candidate
attempt.idea: Revisit confirmation bias as a new cross-method prior-role mechanism with a new benchmark.
attempt.mechanism: Prior role entanglement changes the effective intervention response across methods and must be separated from single-implementation artifacts.
attempt.failure_condition: The effect appears in only one implementation or disappears under an artifact control.
assumptions: A new benchmark is sufficient to establish a new mechanism

attempt.title: IBML broad revisit
attempt.idea: Rebuild the reliability and complementarity phase diagram on a new model family.
attempt.mechanism: Reliability and complementarity jointly determine a broad phase diagram of collaboration performance across tasks and models.
attempt.failure_condition: A near-neighbor problem or a trivial estimator already explains the same phase structure.
assumptions: Changing the model family creates a new research question

attempt.title: IBML identifiability narrow
attempt.idea: Test when observable control statistics cannot identify reliability and complementarity separately.
attempt.mechanism: Reliability and complementarity jointly determine a broad phase diagram of collaboration performance across tasks and models, but observable control statistics may make the two factors unidentifiable.
attempt.failure_condition: A simple estimator identifies both factors or the observation restriction does not change the old conclusion.
assumptions: The observation map can be explicitly restricted
A trivial estimator control is available
attempt.differentiator: Restrict the observation map so control statistics are unidentifiable; test the identifiability boundary instead of redrawing the broad phase diagram.

attempt.title: CodeAlign early mechanism
attempt.idea: Run an early precheck for representation-mediated code transfer before later engineering findings.
attempt.mechanism: Representation alignment mediates robust code transfer when data composition is controlled and the checkpoint supports the required intervention.
attempt.failure_condition: The alignment intervention cannot be distinguished from data mixture effects.
assumptions: The checkpoint available at this cutoff supports the intervention
attempt.differentiator: Add a direct representation intervention while matching data composition and checkpoint quality.

attempt.title: CodeAlign late engineering
attempt.idea: Continue the code transfer program after the required checkpoint became unavailable.
attempt.mechanism: Representation alignment mediates robust code transfer when data composition is controlled and the checkpoint supports the required intervention.
attempt.failure_condition: The required checkpoint or minimum data is unavailable.
assumptions: Engineering substitutions will eventually reproduce the required intervention
attempt.differentiator: Use a substitute checkpoint without first establishing intervention equivalence.
